messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Tue, Aug 10, 2021, Lida Cheng wrote:
>
>I am trying to install amber on a linux subsystem.
>
>
>CondaHTTPError: HTTP 000 CONNECTION FAILED for url <
>
https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/main/linux-64/current_repodata.json
>
>Elapsed: -
>
>An HTTP error occurred when trying to retrieve this URL.
>HTTP errors are often intermittent, and a simple retry will get you on your
>way.
>
>If your current network has
https://www.anaconda.com
blocked, please file
>a support request with your network engineering team.
The error message above indicates the problem: your system is unable to
connect to anaconda.com. You might try copying and pasting the address
into your broswer:
https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/main/linux-64/current_repodata.json
Success or failure there would help narrow down the problem. As the message
suggests, simply trying again later often helps.
...good luck...dac

On Thu, Aug 12, 2021, Lida Cheng wrote:
>
>I am trying to install amber on a linux subsystem.

>But I encountered this problem. Could you please help me solve it?
>
>CondaHTTPError: HTTP 000 CONNECTION FAILED for url <
>
https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/main/linux-64/current_repodata.json

A repsonse has already been made for this question:
http://archive.ambermd.org/202108/0055.html
Please be sure that you are getting email from the Amber mailing list, e.g.
that it is not being diverted to a spam folder.
....dac
